gloss: leaving as is; deferment; keeping unchanged

definitions.gloss: leaving as is; keeping unchanged; maintaining the status quo
definitions.explanation: Keeping something at its current level or state without changing it. Most commonly used for interest rates, prices, taxes, or policies that are maintained rather than raised or lowered.

examples.japanese: {金利|きんり}は{据|す}え{置|お}きとなった。
examples.english: The interest rate was left unchanged.

examples.japanese: {価格|かかく}{据|す}え{置|お}きで{販売|はんばい}を{続|つづ}ける。
examples.english: To continue selling at the same price.

examples.japanese: {中央銀行|ちゅうおうぎんこう}は{政策金利|せいさくきんり}の{据|す}え{置|お}きを{決定|けってい}した。
examples.english: The central bank decided to keep the policy interest rate unchanged.

notes: From the verb {据|す}え{置|お}く (to leave in place). Very common in financial and economic news. Common collocations: {金利|きんり}{据|す}え{置|お}き (unchanged interest rate), {価格|かかく}{据|す}え{置|お}き (price freeze), {据|す}え{置|お}き{期間|きかん} (grace period, deferment period — e.g., before loan repayment begins). Often appears as a compound modifier: {据|す}え{置|お}き{型|がた} (stationary type, as opposed to portable).
